name: What are the benefits of using porcelain tile versus ceramic tile for surface updates?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of using porcelain tile versus ceramic tile for surface updates?

acceptedAnswer.text: Porcelain tile is generally denser, less porous, and more durable than ceramic tile, making it highly resistant to moisture, stains, and heavy traffic. This makes porcelain an excellent choice for high-traffic areas, bathrooms, and outdoor applications, whereas ceramic is often preferred for lighter-traffic indoor areas. While porcelain may have a higher upfront cost, its longevity and low maintenance can offer a greater long-term value, which is a practical tradeoff to consider based on your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Porcelain is denser, less porous, and more durable than ceramic, ideal for high-traffic and wet areas. Ceramic is suited for lighter-traffic indoors. Consider longevity vs. upfront cost.
